title: Resuming after an interruption re-arms: the violation attaches at the fourth occurrence

boundary.expect: third occurrence, but its span carries the king-move interruption: already a neutral claimable draw, not yet a chase violation

rationale: mx-chs-021 continued for one further chase cycle. The three occurrences at plies 4, 8 and 12 are spanned only by Red moves that each renew the attack on the same cannon, so the violation attaches there even though the position has already stood on the board twice before. This pins that the three occurrences need not be the first three: a side that interrupts its own sequence and resumes becomes liable again, and the chasing side (Red) loses at the fourth occurrence.
